title: The Scott-Vogelius element is inf-sup stable on Freudenthal meshes for $k \geq 4$
summary: The Scott-Vogelius element is a classical divergence-free mixed finite element for the Stokes problem that has attracted decades of research attention, yet its theoretical framework remains incomplete. In two dimensions, the inf-sup stability on Freudenthal and other regular meshes has been rigorously established. In three dimensions, Zhang established inf-sup stability on Freudenthal meshes for $k\ge6$ in 2011, while numerical evidence indicates that inf-sup stability remains true for $k=4,5$.
